text: To reset your password, open Settings, choose Security and select Reset password. A reset link is emailed to you and expires after 30 minutes.
Two-factor authentication is turned on under Settings > Security > Two-factor. Authenticator apps and hardware keys are supported, not SMS.
After five failed sign-in attempts an account is locked for 15 minutes. An owner can unlock it sooner from Members.
Invoices are under Billing > Invoices. Select an invoice and choose Download to get a PDF.
Annual plans can be refunded in full within 14 days of purchase. Monthly plans are not refunded, but cancelling stops the next charge.
To cancel, open Billing > Plan and choose Cancel plan. The workspace stays active until the end of the paid period.
Upgrades take effect immediately and are prorated. Downgrades take effect at the next renewal.
Visa, Mastercard and American Express cards are accepted, and bank transfer on annual plans.
Owners can export all workspace data as CSV from Settings > Data > Export. Exports over 1 GB are split into parts and emailed as links valid for 7 days.
Clients and items can be imported from a CSV file with a header row, up to 10,000 rows per import.
A recurring invoice is sent automatically on its schedule: weekly, monthly or yearly. Pause or stop it from the invoice's menu.
A late fee can be added as a fixed amount or a percentage. It is applied once, when an invoice becomes overdue.
Owners and admins invite members from Members > Invite. The Free plan allows 3 members; paid plans have no limit.
There are three roles: owner, admin and member. Only owners can delete the workspace or change billing.
Tax rates are set per item or per invoice under Settings > Taxes. Several rates can apply to one line.
The mobile app can create invoices offline; they are sent once the device reconnects.
A deleted workspace can be restored by an owner for 30 days. After that grace period the deletion is permanent.
Each invoice has its own currency. Reports convert totals to the workspace's base currency at the daily rate.
